title: Credit what works, specifically
statement: Name what works in a lesson, specifically, as well as what fails, because an audit that concedes nothing reads as rhetoric.
detail: The reading course's agent spec lists conceding genuine strengths up front among its red-team agent's lessons from rejected work, since an audit that concedes nothing reads as rhetoric (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/course-formula-agents.md`, line 172). Its quality gates' operating rules end on the same point: credit what is good, specifically (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/key-quality-gates.md`, line 154). Both are adopted rules; neither records a measured effect.

evidence.quote: *Concede genuine strengths up front* — an audit that concedes nothing reads as rhetoric
I would explicitly credit what’s already there: one consistent Archivist, the pinned question, vocabulary support, worked reasoning, a fading model and a different quotation for independent writing.
Don't levy criticism for the sake of it, only if it adds constructive value.
